excluded_identities.name: Activision Blizzard, Inc.

excluded_identities.reason: Original Life Technologies was acquired. Later LIFE ticker usage is not accepted as old Life Technologies continuity.

excluded_identities.reason: Virgin Media acquired; cash/share consideration and legacy series not audited.

excluded_identities.reason: Stericycle acquired; legacy history and terminal cash consideration required.

excluded_identities.name: Nuance Communications, Inc.
excluded_identities.reason: Nuance acquired by Microsoft; legacy history and terminal cash consideration required.

excluded_identities.name: Linear Technology Corp.

excluded_identities.name: BMC Software, Inc.

excluded_identities.name: Sears Holdings Corp.

excluded_identities.name: Electronic Arts, Inc.

excluded_identities.name: Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, Inc.
excluded_identities.reason: Green Mountain/Keurig taken private; do not substitute later KDP history.

excluded_identities.name: Warner Chilcott PLC, Class A
excluded_identities.reason: Warner Chilcott merger chain unresolved; no present-day acquirer substitution.

excluded_identities.name: Apollo Group, Inc., Class A
excluded_identities.reason: Apollo Education taken private; do not confuse original APOL with Apollo Global Management APO.

excluded_identities.name: Alcoa, Inc.
excluded_identities.reason: Original Alcoa split into Alcoa Corp and Arconic, followed by further separation. Today's AA is not the original 2012 issuer's complete lineage; unresolved distribution/reused-symbol chain.

excluded_identities.name: E.I. du Pont de Nemours & Co.
excluded_identities.reason: Original E.I. du Pont merged into DowDuPont then separated into multiple issuers. Today's DD is not accepted as a simple uninterrupted old-DD series without an audited chain.

excluded_identities.reason: United Technologies separated Carrier/Otis and combined with Raytheon. RTX continuity and distribution adjustments require an audited chain; excluded provisionally.
